feeds.title: ShopPerfume Blog
feeds.description: ShoPerfumes is a Canadian online business trying to deliver to Canadians great products at great prices whenever possible. Discover the enchanting world of fragrances through a dedicated perfume blog. REvamp your Fragrance choices with a curated collection of the best current ranges from ShopPerfume.

feeds.title: Canadian Beauty » Perfumes
feeds.description: Find articles elaborating on the latest Perfumes and Skincare routines in vogue. Canadian Beauty is a blog by Beauty Blogger Henna. She posts news and reviews about beauty products, visits the latest salons and spas, and talks about the hottest beauty treatments.

feeds.title: Parfum Exquis Blog
feeds.description: Parfum Exquis is the most sophisticated perfume blog on the internet. Offers in-depth reviews of both high-end and niche perfumes, as well as industry news and updates. Visit their website to learn more! Parfum Exquis is a Montreal niche perfumes store Boutique.

feeds.title: Wani Perfumes Blog
feeds.description: Discover the best Fragrances and secrets behind the many spices and musk used by Wani in this blog. Wani Perfumes is a luxury perfume brand from the Sultanate of Oman. A fusion of the exotic ancient fragrances of the East with the urban scents of the West,

feeds.title: Lothantique Canada Blog
feeds.description: Take inspiration from Lothantique Canada for your next Frangabce gift ideas. Join a passionate team of writers as they discuss and explore French Country living and the amazing products and brands available from Lothantique, a Canadian Perfume business that presents quality and luxury goods sourced from around the world.

feeds.title: Kanopé Fragrances Blog
feeds.description: Journey into the world of Kanopé Fragrances with their blog, guided by a dedicated scent lover. Unveil the mysteries of fragrance creation, explore the harmony of scent families, and delve into captivating stories that weave together the art and science of perfumery.

feeds.title: Etiket Journal » Fragrance
feeds.description: Step into a fragrant world through the Fragrance blog Etiket Journal. Guided by a scent enthusiast, it unravels the secrets of scents, from floral notes to musky undertones. Etiket Journal is a leading Candian Voice on Skincare, Beauty, Lifestyle, and Fragrance topical trends in Canada.

feeds.title: Chromelle Blog
feeds.description: Chromelle's Blog exists to help people with common questions and to have a fun place to talk perfume. Complete with Influencer tips, Gift guides, Scent Descriptions, and more. Chromelle Blog is a luxurious perfume oils business based in Toronto Canada, creating and selling some of the most amazing natural fragrances.

feeds.title: Ayala Moriel Parfums Blog
feeds.description: Ayala Moriel Parfums is an independent artisan perfume house by Ayala Moriel dedicated to the art of natural perfumery. She designs and handcrafts natural perfumes from pure, precious botanical essences that are carefully selected from around the world. Read articles on her travels, trips and more.

feeds.title: DALY BEAUTY
feeds.description: Jane is an acclaimed beauty expert who has also worked for many years in the beauty industry, in the promotion and new brand launches. She shares her beauty expertise with a diverse audience, based primarily in the US, as well as numerous readers in Canada and scattered around the world.

feeds.title: Zoologist Canada Blog
feeds.description: Zoologist Canada offers a line of perfumes that captures the idiosyncrasies of the animal kingdom and transforms them into scents that are unusual, beautiful, fun, and even shocking. Their blog unravels the stories behind every bottle, offering insights into the art of perfumery and helping you find the perfect signature scent.

feeds.title: The 7 Virtues Beauty Blog
feeds.description: The founder, author, and activist at 7 Virtues Beauty, Barb Stegemann shares why sustainably sourced ingredients from nations rebuilding after war or strife are in the DNA of this brand from day one. 7 Virtues Beauty is a perfume supplier specializing in organic essential oils supporting nations' rebuilding.

feeds.title: Perfume Elegance Blog
feeds.description: Blog offers the best tips and recommendations to buy perfumes of a variety in Canada. Perfume Elegance is the go-to online Perfumes shop that offers affordable prices to our customers. Being in the perfume Business since 2003, Perfume Elegance offers the Largest Collections Of 100% Branded Perfumes and Colognes.

feeds.title: Scentrique Blog
feeds.description: Learn about niche perfumes, how to choose the right fragrance, niche perfume samples, gift ideas, perfume sales, and much more! Check out Scentrique's most recent blog posts here. Scentrique is Vancouver's prime independent perfumery and a destination for those who love fragrance or looking to stand out and express themselves.

feeds.title: Lvnea Blog
feeds.description: Elevate your senses with musings on natural perfumery and fragrant botanicals. Browse aromatic experiences, featured scents of the month, and general scent resources. Lvnea explores the spaces between the natural world and of the ethereal. With a focus on pure plant essences and unexpected aromatic combinations, and natural raw materials.

feeds.title: Scent Lodge
feeds.description: Scent Lodge, a northern adventure in fragrance that celebrates the art and science of perfumery. This Canadian editorial website offers the best scent tips and tricks, perfumer interviews, new launches and global fragrance trends. You'll learn about the art of perfume bottle design, how to pursue a career in the fragrance industry and how to enjoy each and every scent you purchase.
